notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Liliana by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Carrion Feeder either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
Carrion Feeder dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, not putting a +1/+1 counter on it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2.
